_comment: Realistic (真实物体) theme — daytime PBR. Natural daylight palette: hazy sky background, glass-blue buildings, greenery garage, warm sun accent. NO shader grid — the scene uses PMREM environment + sun directional light + soft shadows + textured ground instead. Same key names as the cyber theme so the generator derives colors the same way; only the values change. To retheme, edit values here only.

category._comment: Legend category → color. building = glass blue, garage = greenery green. On-screen Legend swatches use these.

building._comment: v1.4 楼栋楼层/房间层次（§4）。日间写实：中等明度阶梯模拟玻璃幕墙反射差异；dividerColor 用中性深色作楼层虚线。

shaders._comment: Not used by the realistic style — no grid floor. Kept for schema symmetry; the generator skips grid.glsl when spec.style != 'cyber'.

environment._comment: v1.2 园区环境配色（§10）。日间写实气质：哑光沥青 + 白黄标线 + 自然草绿 + 棕干绿冠。路灯仅作金属玻璃灯头，日光下不挂 PointLight。

garageEntrance._comment: v1.4 地下车库入口标记（§5）。PBR 金属玻璃感 + 接受阳光阴影。signBg/signFg 高对比（浅底深字）。

surfaceParking._comment: v1.4 地面车位（§10）。长方形车位，哑光沥青底 + 白描边，浅底深字 P，真实车身色。旧 frame/sign 已废弃保留兼容。

poi._comment: v1.3 兴趣点（§11）类型→颜色。日间：自然饱和、接受阴影、不发光。
